description: Header file defining the VaapiVideoDecoder class for VA-API based video decoding in Chromium, including class declarations, member functions, and internal state management.

classes.name: VaapiVideoDecoder
classes.description: Class implementing VA-API based hardware-accelerated video decoding, managing decode pipeline, surfaces, and state transitions.

classes.name: DecodeTask
classes.description: Struct representing a single decode request with associated buffer and callback.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Enumeration of the various states of the decoder, including uninitialized, decoding, flushing, error, etc.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static method to create a new instance of VaapiVideoDecoder.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with configuration, CDM context, and callback handlers.

methods.name: NeedsBitstreamConversion
methods.description: Indicates if bitstream conversion is needed.

methods.name: CanReadWithoutStalling
methods.description: Checks if the decoder can read without stalling.

methods.name: GetMaxDecodeRequests
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of decode requests supported.

methods.name: IsPlatformDecoder
methods.description: Indicates if this is a platform-specific decoder.

methods.name: CreateSurface
methods.description: Creates a new VASurface for decoding.

methods.name: SurfaceReady
methods.description: Callback when a surface is ready for use.

methods.name: set_ignore_resolution_changes_to_smaller_vp9_for_testing
methods.description: Sets a testing flag to ignore resolution changes to smaller VP9.
